reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    nums = sorted([int(x) for x in data[1:1+n]])
    from itertools import permutations
    perms = list(permutations(nums))
    print(len(perms))
    for p in perms:
        print(' '.join(map(str, p)))
